inspectedText: Louisiana Endowment for the Humanities' encyclopedia describes a1980 drilling accident above a salt mine at LakePeigneur, a whirlpool swallowing barges and a reversal of the DelcambreCanal. It attributes the puncture to measurement error and describes liability. Those detailed blame/measurement claims require stronger primary evidence; its reading list includes popular retellings and settlement newspaper articles. A1981MSHA mine-inundation report was located bibliographically but its PDF fetch failed502 and DNS failure, so none of its conclusions were inspected. The disaster and geographic transformation are strong editorial leads; inaccessible primary evidence is a research limitation, not proof of a weak publishing opportunity. Dissolution/erosion feedback and exact depths/volumes remain to verify.
